guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.title: Wedding Photo Book: Page Count, Bleed and Resolution
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.desc: Plan a wedding photo book that prints cleanly: page-count rules, 300 dpi resolution, bleed and gutter margins, and how to avoid tiny faces.
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.lead: A photo book is a print product. Decide the size and page count before laying out a single page, because printers impose both.
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.f1v: 300 dpi at final print size; a 3000 px edge covers a 10-inch side
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.f2v: Usually 3 mm or 1/8 inch of extra image on outer edges
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.f3v: Keep faces and text away from the centre fold
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.f4v: Most books require a multiple of 4, 8 or 16 pages
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.s1: Choose the book size first, then compute the pixel dimensions you need for a full-bleed spread. A 12 × 8 inch landscape spread needs roughly 3600 × 2400 pixels at 300 dpi, plus bleed. Select images by story — preparation, ceremony, portraits, reception, details — rather than by favourites, and give the important photograph a full page instead of shrinking it into a grid.
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.s2: US and UK labs commonly use inch-based sizes and specify bleed in fractions of an inch; European labs quote millimetres and A-series or square formats. Colour profiles differ too: most consumer labs prefer sRGB JPEG, while some professional presses ask for Adobe RGB or CMYK. Check the lab's template before exporting, and order a proof if the book is a gift.
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.s3: The avoidable failures are low-resolution images upscaled to a full spread, faces crossing the gutter, and text placed inside the bleed. Do not rely on screen brightness — a book is viewed in reflected light and usually prints darker than the monitor. Also check skin tones in a soft proof, and never use an image that came from a compressed messaging app for a full-page print.
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.q1: How many photos go in a wedding album?
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.a1: A 40-page book typically holds 60–90 images when mixing full-page shots with small groups. Fewer, larger images almost always look better.
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.a2: 300 dpi at the printed size. For a full 12 × 8 inch spread that is about 3600 × 2400 pixels before bleed.
guides.wedding-photo-book-planner.a3: Extra image beyond the trim edge that gets cut off. It prevents a white sliver if the cut is slightly off; keep text and faces inside the safe margin.
